text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung Disease. The combination of bilious vomiting, abdominal distension, failure to pass meconium, and an X-ray showing dilated bowel loops with a gasless rectum is classic for distal intestinal obstruction caused by aganglionic megacolon.
